scope:
Actual finite-BVP linear response of natural c6 to design directions.

One Jacobian at a successful two-control warm checkpoint is factored. Each
physical profile direction is differentiated in that same numerical chart;
the coupled delta/LB and all free core coefficients respond through the
actual collocation equations. Additional actual q1/q4 directions use exact
inlet derivatives at fixed reference angle chart, with no physical-profile
change inserted directly. These are tangent predictions, never new solved
surfaces, fixed-g refinement, or existence/obstruction certificates.

target_c6_tangent_prediction.scope: First derivative prediction only. A separate full nonlinear solve is mandatory.

rows.physical_state_derivative_scope: The inherited q*max(abs(dy)) measures only the finite Fourier correction coefficients at fixed numerical coordinates. A physical position derivative also includes the moving reference geometry. The complete BVP direction and physical profile direction are saved separately for a valid warm predictor.

control_column_exchange.scope: Linearized replacement of the natural-c6 unknown by one unit of this external physical direction at the same baseline; no nonlinear continuation.
control_column_exchange.ratio_identity: det(J with c6 parameter column replaced by R_field)/det(J)=-dc6_dfield/pscale_c6, with the same column ordering.

exchange_diagnostic.scope:
Instrument one current successful-prefix response Jacobian, without solving.

This leaves strong_control_response.py and its equations unchanged. It saves
the exact coordinate mesh, warm state and linearized field directions, and
examines the small endpoint/parameter matrix after balanced QR elimination.
The reported condition numbers are for that reduced matrix, not the entire
collocation Jacobian and not a proof of a geometric fold. Physical control
column replacements are evaluated at the same successful baseline. No
nonlinear trial, accepted new surface, or fixed-g refinement is produced.

baseline_reduced_matrix.scope: Endpoint/parameter matrix after the same orthogonal interior elimination; not the full BVP condition number.
baseline_reduced_matrix.unit_definition: Physical Fourier correction coefficients=q*y at each endpoint; delta/LB have unit scale; actual c6 and higher coefficients=pscale*p. The moving reference geometry is not included in q*y alone. No row equilibration is inserted.
